decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That details of  landscaping, pursuant to Conditions 7 and 9 of approval,  ref. 00423/56/P4, for the erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to 3 one bedroom flats and 5 two bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicular/ pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces, covered cycle stand, refuse storage areas and landscaping, dated 25/7/2002,  of 3/12/2004, be approved.
description: Following approval for erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing house to 3 one bedroom flats and 5 two bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicular/pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces (3 of which are covered) covered cycle stand, refuse storage area, and landscaping details submitted pursuant to Conditions 7 and 9 (details of hard and soft landscaping) of approved planning permission dated 25/07/2002
